name: Hipster CV
description: Two-column resume/CV with a shaded sidebar (photo, about, languages, contact bubbles), a full-width name banner, and timeline entries with company logos. Sidebar is driven by YAML frontmatter; the markdown body fills the main column. Based on the simplehipstercv class.

features.description: Timeline table of CV entries with a continuous rule (hipster-cv template)
Timeline entry row with role, organization, and optional logo (hipster-cv template)
Year-indexed list for education, patents, or publications (hipster-cv template)
Year-indexed row inside a cvyears block (hipster-cv template)
